emotional_tone: Crisp, precise, competitive, high-stakes Nordic sports tipping

colors.theme: Light primary with Norwegian Crimson Red accents

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.section_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.bento_strategy: MODE B: High Density Precision Grid with distinct 1-U-2 tipping controls and crisp target indicators
spacing_and_layout.card_style: Bordered flat white surface with subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0), crisp inner padding (p-6), hover subtle lift and crimson border highlight

navigation_header.style: Sticky top bar with crystal blur backdrop (bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200)
navigation_header.elements: Logo with Target Icon + 'Riffeltippen', Nav Links (Dueller, Resultater, Lederboard, Mine Tips), User Points Pill, Login/Register or Profile Dropdown, Admin Mode Badge (if admin)

duel_card.layout: Asymmetric duel preview showing Shooter 1 (Red/White badge) vs Shooter 2 (Blue/White badge) with target graphic
duel_card.tipping_buttons: Tri-state segmented selection: [ 1 (Hjemme) | U (Uavgjort) | 2 (Borte) ] with odds/tip percentages and active selection state in vibrant Norwegian Red
duel_card.match_info: Disciplines (f.eks. 10m Luftrifle, 50m Match, Biathlon Sprint), Venue, Start Time / Live Status

leaderboard.layout: High-density clean ranking table with podium highlights for top 3 (Gull, Sølv, Bronse badges), correct tips counter, total points, and accuracy rate %

admin_panel.layout: Clean dashboard modal/tab with duel creation form (select shooters, discipline, date/time) and result input module (score 10.9 precision input, winner/draw declaration, automated tip evaluation button)

results_list.layout: Completed duels timeline with exact scores (e.g. 314.5 vs 312.1), user's tip status badge (Riktig / Feil / Ikke tippet), and points earned notification

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use Norwegian terminology throughout the UI (f.eks. 'Aktive Dueller', 'Sett ditt tip', 'Uavgjort', 'Resultatliste', 'Lederboard', 'Registrer resultat', 'Mine tips').
Ensure the tipping controls (1 - U - 2) feel responsive, crisp, and high contrast. When selected, highlight with bg-red-600 text-white shadow-sm.
Implement clear role separation (Demobruker vs Admin). Provide an easy top toggle or login preset to demonstrate both User experience and Admin duel creation/result registration.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements including tip buttons, login inputs, admin duel submission, and leaderboard tabs.
Include bullseye SVG target graphics and precision decimal score displays (f.eks. 10.9, 10.8) to reinforce the rifle shooting aesthetic.
Do NOT use pure black background (#000000) or generic blue SaaS theme. Stick strictly to crisp white/slate background with crimson red accent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
Ensure header has background or backdrop-blur (never fully transparent over content).
Use proper contrast for hover/focus states.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
